contexts.led_mqtt: The Soundbox status LED: solid green = turning on, blinking green = SIM not detected, blinking blue = searching for network, solid blue = network connected and ready, blinking red = not connected. contexts.network_led: The Soundbox needs an active network connection to receive transaction notifications via MQTT. contexts.led: The Soundbox status LED: solid green = turning on, blinking green = SIM not detected, blinking blue = searching for network, solid blue = network connected and ready, blinking red = not connected.
contexts.sim_led: The Soundbox requires a detected SIM card to connect to the mobile network. The Soundbox status LED: solid green = turning on, blinking green = SIM not detected, blinking blue = searching for network, solid blue = network connected and ready, blinking red = not connected.
contexts.general_led: General Soundbox device status and troubleshooting. The Soundbox status LED: solid green = turning on, blinking green = SIM not detected, blinking blue = searching for network, solid blue = network connected and ready, blinking red = not connected.
